text: Robot go backward to the right moderately and salute.
Robot go forward to the right and salute.
Robot go right moderately and salute.
Robot go backward and keep punching forward.
Robot go backward to the right moderately and punch alternately with right and left hand.
Robot go forward to the right and punch left.
Robot go right moderately and punch right.
Robot go backward and shake both hands.
Robot go backward to the right moderately and shake both hands.
Robot go forward to the right and shake both hands.
Robot go right moderately and shake both hands.
